# Jetforge Labs

> Jetforge Labs is a small studio that makes apps for the little things that eat your time: remembering, typing, checking. It also builds a few custom tools for others.

Jetforge Labs OÜ is a small studio. Everything is built, shipped and supported by the same people.

## Apps

- **Checkmate:** a task list for your Mac. No account, no cloud, free. macOS 15+.
- **Dilo:** writes what you say in any app, and turns calls into notes. On your Mac. macOS 26+, the basic version is free. https://getdilo.co
- **LimitBar:** shows your Claude Code and Codex limits in the menu bar. For developers. macOS 14+, free.

## Custom software

If the friction is bigger, or specific to your team, we can build that too: a tool for how you work, an internal app, a product of your own. Write to hello@jetforgelabs.com.
